decision: ECDEV is a standalone repository; governance is ECDEV-native at .ecdev/
from_authority: former external subsystem directory (byte-identical copy pinned to another repository) at commit 7abc54ed8a874064370cacbd65a206c021874e46
removed_as_accidental_coupling: closed shard registry and the system.shard_registered check (the only failing conformance check: 30/31)
byte-identical protocol snapshot and canonical-subsystem digest checks
multi-repository linker, capsules and system images
organism / material / promotion vocabulary, metrics and checks belonging to another repository
legacy .atlas importer dialects and LEGACY_INPUT shims
migrate scaffold (copying the subsystem into other repositories) and migrate schema (old grammar reader)
upstream registration proposal tooling and one-shot generators that edited declarations in the retired grammar
preserved_machinery: repository graph with stable node identities
typed declarations checked by rustc and read at run time
donor lifecycle evaluator and extinction gates
census (manifests, locks, imports, processes, resident source)
migration waves, path maps and shims

semantic_changes.namespace: node identities derived under `ecdev` (was the external system name); evidence is keyed by locator/subject keys, so no evidence changed meaning
semantic_changes.record_format: YNV/.ynv -> ECG/.ecg; 534 records re-encoded and round-trip verified; map in record-format-migration.json
semantic_changes.relevance: per-capability external-relevance field replaced by ECDEV relevance: RELIED_ON (required) or NOT_RELEVANT_TO_ECDEV (not required, tracked exclusion review); all prior values were judgements about another repository and were reset to UNRESOLVED
semantic_changes.ladder: NORL_RELEVANCE_RESOLVED -> CAPABILITY_RELEVANCE_RESOLVED at the same rung; its gate now covers every declared capability, not only required ones
semantic_changes.graph: every edge endpoint must resolve inside the ECDEV graph (no foreign references)
semantic_changes.conformance: ECDEV REPOSITORY CONFORMANCE: 27 checks of ECDEV invariants, including governance.single_authority, governance.no_external_authority, lifecycle.relevance_justified and shape.graph_owned_source
semantic_changes.universe: research/commerce/donors/registry.json is now a reconciled universe source; it was found STALE (changed since import) and re-imported (9 records added, 7 changed)
semantic_changes.mcp: ecdev.ynventa.* tools -> ecdev.governance.*; extinction/absorption now return the recorded lifecycle instead of a hard-coded blocker list; added ecdev.governance.conformance

equivalence_proof.method: ecdev-gov extinction --json and metrics --json compared against the pre-migration assessment of the same tree
